description: Source code for importing and processing archive files in the Focalboard server, including functions for reading ZIP archives, converting legacy formats, and managing boards and blocks.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods for importing archives, fixing images, and converting blocks to boards.

methods.name: ImportArchive
methods.description: Imports an archive ZIP file containing boards, images, and content, handling legacy formats.

methods.name: ImportBoardJSONL
methods.description: Imports a JSONL file containing blocks for a single board, creating or updating the board and its blocks.

methods.name: fixImagesAttachments
methods.description: Updates image and attachment blocks with correct file IDs after import.

methods.name: blockToBoard
methods.description: Converts a legacy block into a board object.

methods.name: fixBoardsandBlocks
methods.description: Allows modification or filtering of boards and blocks during import via callbacks.
